description: The Norwegian Offshore Directorate FactPages provide information about petroleum activities on the Norwegian continental shelf. The landing page identifies production and transport licences, field production, wellbore information and carbon-dioxide storage topics. The provider is Norwegian Offshore Directorate. Coverage: Coverage is the Norwegian continental shelf. The provider states daily synchronisation with its internal databases. The historical time span and field-level spatial resolution depend on the selected table. Access: Information is published through web pages with links to FactMaps and map services. No complete table or map layer was downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider permits use under NLOD, while explicitly warning that reports, core images, logs and other third-party material may have separate rights. Limitations: Daily synchronisation does not establish the freshness of every underlying observation. Detailed table schemas were not checked. For simulation, the pages supply asset, licensing and production context for petroleum-system and capacity studies. Related resources: No directly related catalogue record was established by the identity checks, including searches for FactPages, Fact Pages and the Sodir address.
